newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT- Lazard starts Ticketmaster.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- Lazard starts Ticketmaster.

text.p: -- Lazard Freres analyst Michael Rosen initiated coverage of Ticketmaster Group Inc with a buy and set a near-term price target over the next three to six months of $15 to $16 and a longer-term price target in the low- to mid-20s.

-- In published comments, Rosen set no earnings estimates. Instead, he provided estimates of Earnings Before Income Taxes, Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) of $33 million in fiscal 1997 ending in January and $47 million in fiscal 1998, versus proforma EBITDA of $23 million in fiscal 1996.

-- He wrote that "Multiple expansion from the current depressed level coupled with growth in expected earnings lead us to believe that TKTM shares are likely to appreciate at least 40 to 50 percent over the near term."
-- "Longer-term, once TKTM becomes an earnings per share driven stock (calendar year 1998) we believe that it is likely to trade into the low- to mid-$20s," Rosen said.
